name: Wumpus Hunt
author: Troy Wiegand
description: A take on the classic Hunt the Wumpus: move between rooms, look around for clues and shoot to take down the Wumpus.

descriptions.en: A take on the classic Hunt the Wumpus: move between rooms, look around for clues and shoot to take down the Wumpus.
descriptions.it: Una versione del classico Hunt the Wumpus: spostati tra le stanze, guardati intorno in cerca di indizi e spara per abbattere il Wumpus.
